exposure: Application of autologous amniotic fluid mixed with calcium chloride solution to surgical repair layers during cesarean delivery closure
outcome: Feasibility of amniotic fluid collection and reapplication
cohort: Twenty pregnant individuals undergoing cesarean delivery were enrolled to assess the collection and reapplication of autologous amniotic fluid to closure layers.
finding: The CeaLogic Specimen Collection and Ratio Applicator Kits can successfully collect and reapply autologous amniotic fluid during cesarean delivery, with observed good wound appearance and no complications or infections in the initial six-week follow-up.
mod_finding: The study demonstrated the feasibility of collecting and reapplying autologous amniotic fluid directly to the surgical repair layers during cesarean delivery closure, with no wound complications or surgical site infections observed.
